items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people: 32:10 Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
items.claim: In the text, the LORD tells Moses that the people are stiffnecked. He says he will consume them in his wrath and make a great nation of Moses instead, and he asks Moses to let him alone so this can happen.
items.action: declares intent to consume the people and make a great nation of Moses
items.mechanism: divine wrath waxing hot against the people, conditioned on Moses letting him alone
